title: Racket Session Duration Sport Leaderboard
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racket:session
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_value max(duration_min) as peak_value count as sessions by sport
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks sport values by average and peak session duration in minutes, helping you see where racket session duration performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which sport contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `sport` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of sport, average session duration in minutes, and peak session duration in minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which sport areas give you the strongest racket session duration results.
